units.source: Custom app-wide CSS
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS

units.source: It is possible to provide a CSS file to be used regardless of the theme set by the user.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS

units.source: The quickest way to create one is __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert child note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Code__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Custom CSS__TRILIUM_PH_5__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Note tree contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS

units.source: Alternatively, create a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Code__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note manually, set the language to CSS and apply the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ label.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS

units.source: Seeing the changes__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Seeing the changes

units.source: Adding a new __TRILIUM_PH_0__app CSS note__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or modifying an existing one does not immediately apply changes. To see the changes, press Ctrl+Shift+R to refresh the page first.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Seeing the changes

units.source: Customizing the printing stylesheet__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Customizing the printing stylesheet

units.source: Since v0.99.2, it's no longer possible to use __TRILIUM_PH_0__ to customize the printing CSS, since the printing is now done in an isolated environment.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Customizing the printing stylesheet

units.source: However, it's still possible to customize the CSS via __TRILIUM_PH_0__; see __TRILIUM_PH_1__Printing & Exporting as PDF__TRILIUM_PH_2__ for more information.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Customizing the printing stylesheet

units.source: When using __TRILIUM_PH_0__Workspaces__TRILIUM_PH_1__, it can be helpful to create a visual distinction between notes in different workspaces.
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Per-workspace styles

units.source: To do so:
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Per-workspace styles

units.source: In the note with __TRILIUM_PH_0__, add an inheritable attribute __TRILIUM_PH_1__ with a value that uniquely identifies the workspace (say __TRILIUM_PH_2__).
units.context: Custom app-wide CSS > Sample use cases > Per-workspace styles

units.source: Anywhere in the note structure, create a CSS note with __TRILIUM_PH_0__.
